title: Owner: choose the wording of the backlog-reader fixture rule
goal: The AGENTS.md rule names files that exist, or is gone by the owner's choice
acceptance: 🧑 The owner picks option (a), (b) or (c) of the full audit 2026-11-26, finding 3; the choice and its date are on B-007
validation: The decision is recorded on B-007

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one choice among three written options. Not a measurement.

escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
